description: Location intelligence — geocode a place, reverse-geocode coordinates, find nearby places (46 POI categories), driving/walking/cycling distance + time, turn-by-turn directions, timezone lookup, bounding box + area for a named place, and POI search within a rectangle. Uses OpenStreetMap + Overpass + OSRM. Free, no API key.
